# opnsense_haproxy_action (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense HAProxy action, including conditional `use_backend` routing used by SNI passthrough frontends.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique action name.
- `type` (String) HAProxy action type, for example `use_backend`, `tcp-request`, or `custom`.

### Optional

- `custom` (String) Raw action content for a `custom` action.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable the action. Defaults to `true`.
- `linked_acls` (Set of String) ACL UUIDs evaluated by this action.
- `operator` (String) Operator joining linked ACLs. Defaults to `and`.
- `tcp_request_action` (String) TCP request action selector.
- `tcp_request_inspect_delay` (String) TCP inspection delay used by applicable request actions.
- `tcp_request_option` (String) TCP request action option.
- `test_type` (String) ACL test type. Defaults to `if`.
- `use_backend` (String) Backend UUID for a `use_backend` action.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the HAProxy action.
